owner_posts.post_text:
Risks of Filing Your ITR Late 


Filing your Income Tax Return (ITR) after the deadline may feel like a small delay… but it can cost you big. Here’s what you risk if you miss the due date:

 Penalty u/s 234F – A late filing fee of up to ₹5,000 can be levied.

 Loss of Carry Forward of Losses – Business or capital losses cannot be carried forward if the return is not filed on time.

 Interest Liability – Interest under Sections 234A, 234B & 234C is charged on pending taxes.

 Refund Delay – Any tax refund you’re entitled to gets unnecessarily delayed.

 Prosecution in Extreme Cases – Continuous default may invite notices and even prosecution.


 Timely filing not only saves you from penalty but also gives you peace of mind.


 Comment “PENALTY” for the FREE GUIDE
